title: Cross-system structural matrix (systems x SME Cat 1-9)
author: Cassia (sme-dreamteam)
posture: Diagnostic, not benchmark. Each cell is a controlled reading of one substrate under stated conditions; cross-system comparison on the structural cats carries the ontology-sensitivity confound the spec flags. N/A means 'the system has no structure to evaluate for this cat' (a finding, not a blank).

scoreability_legend.scoreable: the cat is meaningfully runnable against this system
scoreability_legend.N/A-no-graph: system exposes no graph/edges; structural cat cannot be evaluated
scoreability_legend.N/A-no-harness: system is a pure library; no invocation surface to probe
scoreability_legend.ceiling-corpus-declared: edges were hand-declared by the corpus (good-dog-graph); the +1.00 is a ceiling case, not emergent detection
scoreability_legend.emergent: edges were GENERATED by the system's own pipeline (not corpus-declared); the reading measures real emergent structure
scoreability_legend.pending-adapter: adapter not yet merged to main; slot reserved

omega.note: OMEGA session-level hit@K, same subset/rendering; -2.7pp = 4 questions of 150

2c.name: The Stairway (multi-hop / multi-session R@5)
2c.corpus: LongMemEval-S strat150 (cat_2c multi-session) for OMEGA/mempalace; jp-realm by-hop for mempalace-daemon AGE

mempalace.note: 0.933 mean by-hop on jp-realm AGE (Condition-B-only); 0.960 cat_2c on LongMemEval strat150
6/6 corpus-DECLARED contradicts edges surfaced via good-dog-graph; precision 1.00. Ceiling case on a corpus that declares its contradicts edges.

omega.metric: EMERGENT contradicts edges vs good-dog ground-truth themes
omega.note: OMEGA auto-relate GENERATED 4 contradicts edges from note text (not corpus-declared). 1 of 2 ground-truth themes detected (grain-free DCM caught, dominance-theory missed); 1 of 4 edges is a true positive. The self-consistency read (sme-eval cat3 --adapter omega) is a tautological 1.00 and is NOT the comparable number; this emergent-vs-ground-truth read is.

mempalace.note: live palace AGE: 0/1106 collisions, 1.000 coverage, normalized entropy 0.020 (tunnel = 98.98%, severe monoculture expected for a tunnel-dense palace)

omega.note: good-dog auto-relate: 24 notes ingested -> 18 memories (6 content-hash deduped). 0 canonical collisions, 100% field coverage, normalized edge entropy 0.78 over 3 emergent types (temporal_cluster 61%, evolution 31%, contradicts 7%) -- a far more balanced edge vocabulary than the mempalace tunnel-monoculture.

mempalace.note: live palace AGE: heavily fragmented working palace

omega.note: good-dog auto-relate: single fully-connected component, 0 isolates, one persistent H1 hole (max persistence 1.00). NOTE: required an adapter fix (entity id = node_id not integer id) so the 54 emergent edges resolve against the node set; pre-fix every edge dangled and the read collapsed to all-isolates.

mempalace.note: 8/8 corpus-DECLARED supersedes edges resolved into _superseded_by, 5 chains incl. 4-doc Hill's chain. Ceiling case.

omega.note: OMEGA auto-relate emitted 0 supersedes edges. Its temporal-shift analogue is the `evolution` edge type (17 edges), which does NOT carry directional supersession semantics and does not normalize to a supersedes predicate, so SME Cat 6 reads completeness 0.00. Honest finding: OMEGA has a temporal edge type but no SME-recognized supersession-completeness.

7.name: The Abacus (token efficiency / E2E QA)
7.corpus: LongMemEval-S strat150 (o4-mini reader + gpt-5.3-chat judge, sme-rich)

mempalace.note: o4-mini reader on retrieved context, 4-cat macro. The 52.9k tokens-per-correct on jp-realm Cat 1 is the mempalace single-condition efficiency reading; A/B/C deltas need a flat jp-realm baseline (gap).

omega.note: OMEGA QA 0.593 macro ~= parity (+1.3pp) with the same-reader mempalace 0.580. Different per-cat profile (OMEGA leads cat_1/cat_3, daemon leads cat_2c/cat_6). NOT comparable to OMEGA's self-reported 95.4% (that uses GPT-4.1 reader). Caveat: daemon comparator was oracle-n500 not strat150-S.

mempalace.note: live palace AGE; 'hierarchical' claim FAILS (modularity 0.009); no health-check API -> introspection 0.0

omega.note: good-dog auto-relate vs OMEGA's declared README vocabulary. 8b edge-vocab coverage 33.3% (found `contradicts`; `related`/`supersedes` absent) + 2 UNDECLARED emergent types (`evolution`, `temporal_cluster`). 8d drift 87.5% -- OMEGA's documented edge model and its emergent edge model diverge substantially. 8a type-coverage 0% is a CORPUS-COVERAGE artifact (all good-dog notes ingested as the default `summary` event_type; the 5 declared types weren't exercised) -- caveat, not an OMEGA ontology failure. No introspection API.

mempalace.note: Cat 9a tracks the ORCHESTRATOR's Tau2 score, not the substrate. opus-4-8 -> 100% invocation / 98.3% recall on the daemon retrieval path.

omega.note: OMEGA is a pure Python library (and an MCP server, not exercised here). Cat 9a measures whether an ORCHESTRATOR model invokes the memory tool; that is an orchestrator-model property, not a substrate property. On this harness OMEGA was driven via its library API (no model-in-the-loop), so 9a is N/A for the substrate -- the same way mempalace's 9a number is really a property of the opus-4-8 orchestrator in front of it, not of mempalace.

OmegaAdapter declares no get_harness_manifest() -- pure library usage. Cat 9b empty-manifest = does-not-apply (a real finding: OMEGA ships an MCP server but the SME adapter uses the library path, so there is no harness surface to probe through the adapter).
